source_quotes: review all, finalize all edits, ensure all captured while builds/tests were locked
no build no test ... ensure everything is aligned
overlap_check: method_4 (30004) is general code review; method_7 and method_28 are test practice. None addresses reviewing unbuilt edits. New.

payload.name: Review Parse-Only Edits Like a Compiler
payload.description: Edits that were only parsed are not verified. Before they are called final, the whole diff is read for what a compiler and a test would find, and every bug class found is searched for everywhere.

principles.name: Parsing proves syntax
principles.description: A formatter passes code a compiler would reject or a test would fail.

heuristics.condition: edits are described as finalized while the build is locked
heuristics.action: list what has never compiled and expect errors on the first real check

heuristics.condition: a data reader looks only in one directory
heuristics.action: check every reader of the same stored path for the same blind spot

decision_rules.name: Diff against the last good build
decision_rules.condition: edits exist that were never compiled or tested
decision_rules.outcome: diff them against the last commit that was compiled and deployed and read every hunk

decision_rules.name: Read for compiler faults
decision_rules.outcome: check await inside non-async closures, values moved then reused, wrong argument counts, missing module declarations, imports and struct fields, and dependencies that were never added

decision_rules.name: Search the same class everywhere
decision_rules.outcome: grep for the same pattern in every other place (every reader of a path, every await in a closure) before moving on

decision_rules.name: Check what a removed helper guaranteed
decision_rules.condition: a helper or reader is deleted
decision_rules.outcome: find what it used to guarantee and where that guarantee now lives

decision_rules.name: Capture the review
decision_rules.outcome: record it with the checklist and the status document, and say it was a reading, not a build
